# TemuGlowz

TemuGlowz is an independent project for people who want to organize Temu shopping links and compare curated product selections.

## Public guides

- Kitchen gadgets: /guides/kitchen-gadgets
- Summer cooling: /guides/summer-cooling

Only these published guides are intended as current public recommendation pages. Product details, prices, variants and availability can change; readers should verify them on Temu before ordering.

## Editorial approach

- TemuGlowz is not currently an official Temu partner.
- Published selections are editorial curation, not hands-on product testing unless a page explicitly documents that evidence.
- If TemuGlowz later uses affiliate links, the relationship and possible commission will be disclosed clearly near recommendations.
- TemuGlowz does not claim verified sellers, live availability, guaranteed prices or paid placements without documented proof.
